Hi team,

I pulled together the first pass of the QBR packet (attached). Focus areas: pipeline cleanliness, four account spotlights (Acme, Stratus Cloud, Solara Health, Vertex Labs), and a concise runbook outlining owner asks for the exec readout.

Asks (24–36h turnaround please):
- Marissa: please annotate the three accounts you think need an expansion play vs. risk mitigation (use the Account Notes tab in the spreadsheet).
- Rishi: add risk tags and a short mitigation line for any deals you put in "Commit" that have technical blockers.
- Laura / Naomi: high-level one-line guidance I can surface to execs (2–3 bullets on runway / bookings health).

Attachments: QBR_account_summaries_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet, 42KB), QBR_pipeline_runbook_v1.md (markdown, 6KB)

Key constraints I used in the forecast sheet: 60% conversion on late-stage pipeline where there is active exec engagement; exclude churn-exposed accounts flagged in the MRR sweep. I added a small notes column for unusual contract items (SaaS + Dedicated bundling).

I want to finalize by EOD Monday PST so we can circulate to leadership for sign-off mid-week. If you can't make the 36h window, tell me which accounts you want me to own and I'll assign to CS.

Thanks — Priyom
